# Plan: User Dashboard

## Context
Build a user dashboard that shows account stats, recent activity, and settings.

## Implementation
1. Create a dashboard page at /dashboard
2. Show user stats (posts, followers, engagement rate)
3. Add a recent activity feed
4. Add a settings panel (see D1: settings is its own route, not a panel)
5. ~~Use a clean, modern UI with cards and icons~~ Replaced by D1–D4, D11 and D12 (no cards, no decorative icons)
6. ~~Add a hero section at the top with a gradient background~~ Replaced by D2 page header (no hero, no gradient)

## Technical Details
- React components with Tailwind CSS (theme tokens from D3 go in `tailwind.config` as CSS variables)
- API endpoint: GET /api/dashboard
- WebSocket for real-time activity updates (UI behavior in D5)

## Design Decisions
Surface mode: OPERATE (app UI). The visitor's win is "check my numbers, see what happened, change a setting". App UI rules apply; no landing-page patterns.

### D1 — Information hierarchy
First: stats strip (three numbers). Second: activity feed. Third: settings, moved to `/dashboard/settings` as a nav tab. A settings form competing with live numbers on one screen breaks "if you can only show 3 things".

### D2 — Layout (desktop ≥1024px)
Page header replaces the hero: left `h1` "Dashboard", right a period selector (7d / 30d / 90d). 12-column grid, 1200px max, 24px gutters.

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| header: Dashboard                         [ 7d | 30d | 90d ]     |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STATS STRIP (full width, one surface, hairline dividers)         |
|  Posts        Followers      Engagement                          |
|  1,284 +12    24.1K +3.4%    4.8% -0.2                           |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------+
| ACTIVITY FEED (8 cols)                      | RAIL (4 cols)      |
|  Today                                      |  avatar, name,     |
|  o  Ana followed you            2m          |  handle            |
|  o  Post "..." got 40 likes     1h          |  Settings ->       |
|  Yesterday                                  |                    |
|  ...                                        |                    |
|  [ Show more ]                              |                    |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------+
Nav flow: /dashboard  <-tab->  /dashboard/settings  (back via same tab)
```

### D3 — Tokens (CSS variables, no raw hex in components)
`--color-bg`, `--color-surface`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-accent` (one accent, hue per U1), `--color-positive`, `--color-negative`, `--color-border`. Type scale 14 / 16 / 20 / 28 / 40px, body 16px minimum, stats values 40px with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Spacing scale 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48. Radius 6px on controls only. Depth: 1px borders; the only shadow is on menus (0 4px 12px, soft). No gradients anywhere.

### D4 — Stats strip
Three figures, left-aligned, label (14px muted) above value (40px). Delta vs prior period beside the value as sign + arrow glyph + tinted text, never color alone. Values ≥100,000 use compact notation (24.1K) with the full number in `title` and `aria-label`. No icons, no cards.

### D5 — Activity feed
One list grouped by day with sticky day headings. Row: 32px avatar, one sentence of utility copy ("Ana followed you"), relative time with absolute time on `title`. Rows 56px tall. Pagination via a "Show more" button, 20 per page. Real-time: new WebSocket items never shift the list; a "3 new updates" pill appears at the top of the feed and inserts them on click. A name longer than 32 characters truncates with an ellipsis and keeps the full name in `title`.

### D6 — Settings route
Form sections (Profile, Notifications, Privacy), each with its own Save. Labels sit above fields and stay visible; placeholders are never the only label. Inline validation on blur; errors in `--color-negative` text plus an icon, tied to the field with `aria-describedby`.

### D7 — Interaction states (what the user sees)

| FEATURE | LOADING | EMPTY | ERROR | SUCCESS | PARTIAL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stats strip | 3 skeleton numerals after a 150ms delay, no spinner | Values "0"; copy "Publish your first post to start tracking"; button "Write a post" | Strip keeps last values greyed; inline "Couldn't refresh. Retry" | Numbers count up once (D11) | Period change shows skeleton on numbers only; labels stay |
| Activity feed | 6 skeleton rows matching D5 row height | "Nothing yet. Activity from your posts and followers shows up here." plus link "Share your profile" | Inline block in the feed slot: "Couldn't load activity. Retry"; header and stats stay usable | List renders; new items via D5 pill | Page 2+ failure: "Show more" becomes "Retry loading more"; loaded rows stay |
| Real-time (WS) | n/a | n/a | Footer line "Updated 3 min ago. Reconnecting…", retries with backoff; never a modal | Pill "N new updates" | Reconnected after gap: feed refetches page 1 silently, pill shows the diff |
| Settings | Skeleton form | Never empty; fields show current values | Section-level error above the Save it belongs to | Inline "Saved" text beside the button for 3s, then fades | One section failing leaves other sections untouched |

### D8 — Responsive
- 768–1023px: stats stay 3-across; feed goes full width; rail becomes a single row under the stats with the Settings link right-aligned.
- <768px: stats become a 1-column list, label and value on one line, delta right-aligned. Period selector becomes a native `<select>`. Rail contents move into the header (avatar menu with Settings). Sticky day headings off. Feed rows 64px for touch. Every tappable target ≥44×44px.

### D9 — Accessibility
Landmarks: `header`, `nav`, `main`, `aside`. One `h1`, day headings as `h2`. Feed is a `<ul>` with the new-updates pill in an `aria-live="polite"` region; the list itself is not live. Keyboard order: header → period selector → stats → feed → rail; "Show more" and the pill are buttons. Focus ring 2px `--color-accent`, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Contrast ≥4.5:1 body, ≥3:1 for 40px numerals. Deltas carry sign and glyph (D4). `prefers-reduced-motion` disables D11 and the pill fade. Visited links in feed rows use a muted variant of the link color.

### D10 — Browser surfaces
Selection color, caret, focus ring, and scrollbar thumb themed from `--color-accent` and `--color-border`.

### D11 — Motion
One authored moment: stats numerals count up over 400ms, exponential ease-out, from a visible 0. Nothing else animates except the 150ms pill fade.

### D12 — Copy
Utility language only: orientation, status, action. No "Welcome back", no mood lines. Section headings name the area ("Recent activity", "Profile").

### D13 — Light/dark
Ship light by default (U2 pending). Tokens in D3 are the only thing a dark theme would swap.

## User Journey Storyboard

| STEP | USER DOES | USER FEELS | PLAN SPECIFIES? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Opens /dashboard (5 sec) | "Are my numbers up?" | D2 header + D4 strip first; D7 loading skeleton keeps layout stable |
| 2 | Scans deltas | Relief or concern | D4 sign + glyph + tint; D11 count-up draws the eye once |
| 3 | Reads feed (5 min) | Curious who engaged | D5 sentences, day grouping, relative time |
| 4 | Leaves tab open, returns | Wants what changed | D5 pill, D7 WS reconnect row |
| 5 | First-time user with zero data | Possibly discouraged | D7 empty states name the next action |
| 6 | Changes a setting | Needs confidence it stuck | D6 per-section Save, inline "Saved" |
| 7 | Months later (5 yr) | Trusts the numbers | D4 full values on hover, no decoration drift, D3 tokens |

## NOT in scope
- Dark theme: tokens ready (D3), scene decision open (U2).
- Charts or trend sparklines: adds a second visual system; revisit when there is a history endpoint.
- Export or share of stats: no user ask yet.
- Notification center: feed covers the need; a bell icon would be decoration.

## What already exists
No DESIGN.md, no existing UI components, no prior design reviews (greenfield repo, one commit). Tailwind is the declared styling layer; D3 tokens live in its theme config so later components share one vocabulary.

## TODOS.md updates
1. **What:** Create DESIGN.md via `/design-consultation`. **Why:** U1 and U2 cannot be settled by principle alone; they are brand calls. **Pros:** one vocabulary for every future screen. **Cons:** ~30 min of founder time. **Context:** This review defined structure and tokens but left hue and typeface open. **Depends on:** nothing. Proposed: A) Add to TODOS.md.
2. **What:** Dark theme. **Why:** likely for a tool left open all day. **Pros:** D3 makes it a token swap. **Cons:** doubles contrast QA. **Context:** see U2. **Depends on:** U2. Proposed: A) Add to TODOS.md.

## Implementation Tasks
Synthesized from this review's findings. Each task derives from a specific finding above. Run with Claude Code or Codex; checkbox as you ship.

- [ ] **T1 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Layout — Build D2 grid, header, and `/dashboard/settings` route; delete hero and card wrappers
  - Surfaced by: Pass 1 / Pass 4 — hard rejections 1 and 7
  - Files: `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`, `src/pages/DashboardSettings.tsx`, router
  - Verify: no `bg-gradient` or card wrapper classes in dashboard components; trunk test passes with nav only
- [ ] **T2 (P1, human: ~2h / CC: ~10min)** — Tokens — Add D3 CSS variables to `tailwind.config` and `globals.css`
  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 — no tokens specified
  - Verify: grep components for raw hex; expect zero
- [ ] **T3 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Stats strip — Implement D4 with compact notation and tabular numerals
  - Surfaced by: Pass 1, Pass 4 (icons in circles)
  - Verify: render 1,284 / 24,100 / 1,200,000; check `title` holds full value
- [ ] **T4 (P1, human: ~1.5d / CC: ~30min)** — Activity feed — Implement D5 list, pagination, and new-updates pill over WebSocket
  - Surfaced by: Pass 2 — partial and real-time states unspecified
  - Verify: push 3 WS events; list does not shift; pill reads "3 new updates"
- [ ] **T5 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — States — Implement every D7 cell; add Storybook stories per cell
  - Surfaced by: Pass 2 — no loading, empty, error states
  - Verify: stories exist for all 20 cells; empty state shows "Write a post" button
- [ ] **T6 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Responsive — Implement D8 at 375, 768, 1024, 1440
  - Surfaced by: Pass 6 — no viewport behavior
  - Verify: screenshots at the four widths; all targets ≥44px at 375
- [ ] **T7 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Accessibility — Implement D9 and D10
  - Surfaced by: Pass 6 — no keyboard, ARIA, or contrast spec
  - Verify: axe reports zero violations; keyboard-only run through storyboard steps 1–6
- [ ] **T8 (P2, human: ~2h / CC: ~5min)** — Motion — Implement D11 with `prefers-reduced-motion` guard
  - Surfaced by: Pass 4 — litmus 6
  - Verify: toggle reduced motion in devtools; numerals render static

JSONL artifact not written: this run was non-interactive with no shell access requested; write it on the next interactive run.

## Design Review Passes

Review mode: non-interactive at the user's instruction. Per-issue AskUserQuestion gates, mockups (Step 0.5), outside voices, and Prior Learnings search were not run. Decisions D1–D13 were applied under that instruction; U1–U2 stay open.

**Step 0.** Initial design completeness 2/10. The plan names features, not what the user sees. A 10 for this plan: hierarchy, every state, viewport behavior, a11y, and tokens, which is what D1–D13 now hold. No DESIGN.md; universal principles applied.

### Pass 1: Information Architecture — 2/10 → 9/10
Was: four features in a list, hero on top of a tool. Fix: D1, D2. A 10 adds a verified trunk test on the built nav; one tab plus a header is thin wayfinding until `/dashboard/settings` exists.

### Pass 2: Interaction State Coverage — 1/10 → 9/10
Was: no state named. Fix: D7, with empty states as features. A 10 needs the WebSocket backoff timings and the "Show more" end-of-list copy, left to implementation.

### Pass 3: User Journey & Emotional Arc — 1/10 → 8/10
Was: no user named. Fix: storyboard above, D7 empty states for the discouraged first-timer. A 10 would validate step 5 copy with two real new users and settle U1 so the 5-second visceral read is intentional.

### Pass 4: AI Slop Risk — 2/10 → 9/10
Classifier: OPERATE. Hard rejections hit in the original: #1 generic card grid as first impression, #7 app UI of stacked cards. Blacklist hits: #1 gradient background, #3 icons as decoration, #11 Tailwind default `system-ui` stack implied by naming no typeface. Litmus on the revised plan: 1 brand unmistakable: NO until U1; 2 one anchor: YES, stats strip; 3 scannable by headings: YES (D12); 4 one job per section: YES; 5 cards necessary: NO, and none used; 6 motion improves hierarchy: YES (D11); 7 premium without shadows: YES (D3 has none). All hard rejections resolved by D1–D4. A 10 requires U1 so litmus 1 flips to YES.

### Pass 5: Design System Alignment — 1/10 → 7/10
No DESIGN.md exists; rated on explicit tokens. Was: "Tailwind" only. Fix: D3 plus D10. Remaining gap: typeface and accent hue (U1) are the two loudest tokens and both are open, so this pass stays below 8. A 10 is DESIGN.md with YAML front matter and D3 citing its paths.

### Pass 6: Responsive & Accessibility — 0/10 → 9/10
Was: nothing. Fix: D8, D9. A 10 adds RTL mirroring of the delta glyphs and a screen-reader script for the pill, both cheap once T7 exists.

| U1 Typeface and accent hue (no DESIGN.md) | Tailwind ships `system-ui` and a blue-500 button; litmus 1 fails, Pass 4 and 5 capped |
